mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_nm, d.parent_id, d.sort_no, d.manager_user_id, d.use_yn, m.name AS manager_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_user u WHERE u.dept_id = d.dept_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y') AS headcount FROM gw_dept d LEFT JOIN gw_user m ON m.user_id = d.manager_user_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(d.parent_id, 0), d.sort_no, d.dept_id

SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_nm, d.parent_id, d.sort_no, d.manager_user_id, d.use_yn, m.name AS manager_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_user u WHERE u.dept_id = d.dept_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y') AS headcount FROM gw_dept d LEFT JOIN gw_user m ON m.user_id = d.manager_user_id WHERE d.dept_id = #{deptId}
SELECT position_id, position_nm, level_no, use_yn FROM gw_position WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY level_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_record (user_id, category_cd, title, content, event_dt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryCd}, #{title}, #{content}, #{eventDt})
mapper.sql: r.rec_id, r.user_id, u.name AS user_name, r.category_cd, c.code_nm AS category_nm, r.title, r.content, r.event_dt, r.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_hr_record r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_RECORD_CATEGORY' AND c.code_val = r.category_cd WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.event_dt DESC NULLS LAST, r.rec_id DESC
SELECT FROM gw_hr_record r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_RECORD_CATEGORY' AND c.code_val = r.category_cd ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_history (user_id, change_type_cd, before_json, after_json, effective_dt, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeTypeCd}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{effectiveDt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: h.his_id, h.user_id, u.name AS user_name, h.change_type_cd, c.code_nm AS change_type_nm, h.before_json, h.after_json, h.effective_dt, h.created_at, h.created_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_hr_history h JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_CHANGE_TYPE' AND c.code_val = h.change_type_cd WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.effective_dt DESC, h.his_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_family (user_id, relation_cd, name, birth_dt, dependent_yn, elderly_yn, disabled_yn) VALUES (#{userId}, #{relationCd}, #{name}, #{birthDt}, COALESCE(#{dependentYn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{elderlyYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{disabledYn}, 'N'))
mapper.select: SELECT f.fam_id, f.user_id, u.name AS user_name, f.relation_cd, f.name, f.birth_dt, f.dependent_yn, f.elderly_yn, f.disabled_yn, f.created_at FROM gw_family f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE f.relation_cd WHEN 'SPOUSE' THEN 1 WHEN 'CHILD' THEN 2 WHEN 'PARENT' THEN 3 WHEN 'SIBLING' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END, f.birth_dt

SELECT f.fam_id, f.user_id, u.name AS user_name, f.relation_cd, f.name, f.birth_dt, f.dependent_yn, f.elderly_yn, f.disabled_yn, f.created_at FROM gw_family f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.fam_id = #{famId}
